Option (B) has the following adjective order: [1. opinion] [3. age] [5. color] [6. origin] [7. material] [8. purpose] (or, in numeric terms, 1 3 5 6 7 8). Because 1 < 3 < 5 < 6 < 7 < 8 is correct, (B) has the correct ordering. So the answer is (B).
